enchantments.tooltip: Lifeblood of the Undead Prince: This artifact displays incredible regenerative abilities. You gain a +58 Competence Bonus to Positive and Repair Healing Amplification and +58 Profane Bonus to Negative Healing Amplification.
Constitution +14: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Quality Resistance +2: Passive: +2 Quality bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Quality Sheltering +9: +9 Quality bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings
Mythic Hands Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
